book.title: Ioane Iesu Keriso Hari Manoḡa Ioaneꞌa Mirihiro

content: Iesuꞌa Ane Tahiꞌatahiꞌa Oda Vuzuꞌiro

Iḡine Modiroteꞌe Muiḡa ꞌizema mougano, Iesuꞌe aneꞌa raha ꞌadi modadu Mama vaḡe ititeꞌe madaḡa meirotaꞌaꞌe ederiro. Ebu aneꞌa raha ꞌada ane hegoteꞌeteꞌe azaḡa zamare borofiro, onamo ani rudatiteꞌe madaḡa meiro.
Ḡoravaḡano ze ogomu tiburu aunu. Diaboloꞌa Isakariota vazeḡa Simona ubuga, Iuda zamaḡa amahi tutunadu Iesu revohatihi reiro.
Iesuꞌe ederiro, Moganiꞌa ḡau niduꞌa ani ꞌevora tiro ebu aneꞌa Badiꞌa mazaonoꞌo aradu bare Badiꞌa vaḡe itiꞌuma.
Eꞌanoꞌo ani ogauꞌeteꞌe habaꞌanonoꞌo iḡunadu raga dabuaḡa mae vaḡine tiro, ebu ahiri zauheꞌeteꞌe dabuaḡa madu gabaꞌiḡano autiro.
Ebu siuva duꞌuḡano vu beuꞌadu ane tahiꞌatahiꞌa oda vuzuꞌiro, zu autiroteꞌe dabuaḡa hina zauhiro.
Iesuꞌa Simona Petero vaḡirotene, Peteroꞌa niro, “Zuhiꞌa Boro, ḡa eḡe oda vuzuꞌihi raꞌehe?”
Iesuꞌa naenaeniro, “Eḡeꞌa nagini haḡaeꞌetaꞌaꞌe ḡa izidiꞌe aḡuꞌa, rehano vesuꞌu ederiꞌuma.”
Peteroꞌa ꞌahige rae reiro, “Ḡa eḡe odaꞌe mene hune vuzuꞌiꞌuma!” Iesuꞌa naenaeniro, “Eḡeꞌa ḡae oda mene vuzuꞌine, ḡaꞌe eḡe mene tahiꞌa reꞌuma.”
Simona Peteroꞌa niro, “Zuhiꞌa Boro, eḡe oda daꞌo mene, rehano ꞌevorehe ebu vadinihe zuni vuzuꞌoꞌi.”
Iesuꞌa naenaeniro, “Viriroteꞌe vazeḡaꞌe odaḡa daꞌo vuzuꞌeꞌohe. Ani ahiꞌaꞌe niduꞌa deheḡa. Ebu zaꞌe deheḡa, rehano zae niduꞌa boꞌaḡano tibaꞌe mene deheḡa.”
Iesuꞌe iniuꞌa ani revohatiteꞌe ederiro, eꞌanoꞌo, “Zae boꞌaḡano tibaꞌe mene deheḡa,” rae reiro.
Iesuꞌa odaze vuzuꞌe hauḡirotene, raga dabuaḡa bare haḡadu ogomu fataḡa uhiḡano ehoriro. Ebu aneꞌa ziro, “Za eꞌa zae veize haḡateꞌe haḡaiḡa hugaꞌe edeḡahe?
Za eḡe mazao ihore vazeḡa zu Zuhiꞌa Boro rae huheꞌohe. Zaꞌa raꞌetaꞌaꞌe hube, eꞌe ꞌuguḡa vazeḡa.
Eꞌe zae Zuhiꞌa Boro ebu ihore vazeḡa, rehano zae oda vuzuꞌeha. Eꞌanoꞌo zae zuni ꞌahoganiꞌa ꞌahoga oda vuzuꞌiꞌuma.
Eḡeꞌa zae veize haḡateꞌe teige, zae zuni haḡaifine e ꞌahige haḡadu ihozeha.
Eḡeꞌa hube hune ziꞌohe. Tuḡure vazeḡaꞌe ane zuhiꞌa mene vitinoga, ebu iniuꞌa tuḡuniroteꞌe vazeḡaꞌe ani tuḡuniroteꞌe vazeḡa mene vitinoga.
Za eꞌa izidi haḡataꞌaꞌe ederadu nize mae ovoeꞌenaꞌa vaze danazine, matuꞌe rudaꞌuma.”
Iesu Revohatiteꞌe Vazeḡa
“E zae niduꞌa mazao mene ḡoereꞌohe. E eḡeꞌa ohotiroteꞌe azaḡaꞌe edeḡa. Rehano Buka Zaḡoḡano ꞌahige rae mirihiroteꞌeꞌa hudaꞌuma, 'Eḡe ogomu tiburu auꞌeteꞌe vazeḡaniꞌa ḡihuradu e agirohiro.'
ꞌUguḡaniꞌa ꞌizema fureranogano izidi eḡeꞌa ziꞌohe, mazaḡa ꞌuguḡaniꞌa fureratiteꞌe madaḡano eḡeꞌa eꞌe iniu rae ihoziroteꞌe zaeꞌa mae ḡihinifine raꞌohe.
Eḡeꞌa hube hune ziꞌohe, iniu eḡeꞌa tuḡuneꞌeteꞌe vazeḡa mae ḡihineꞌeteꞌe vazeḡaꞌe eḡe mae ḡihiheꞌohe. Ebu iniu eḡe mae ḡihiheꞌeteꞌe vazeḡaꞌe eḡe tuḡuhiroteꞌe vazeḡa mae ḡihineꞌohe.”
Iesuꞌa ḡoere ꞌadi reirotene, zamaḡaniꞌa adudaro ebu ꞌahige rae fureniro, “Eḡeꞌa hube hune ziꞌohe, zae boꞌaḡano vaze ꞌahoganiꞌa eḡe revoniꞌuma.”
Ebu ane tahiꞌatahiꞌaꞌe aniꞌa iniu moneo reirotaꞌaꞌe mene ederadu ze zeḡeꞌa bare ḡiatitiro.
Iesu zamarone tahiꞌaḡaniꞌa Iesu uhiḡano tave ehore radiro.
Eꞌanoꞌo Simona Peteroꞌa ubumaḡa hina tahiꞌa eꞌe niro, “Ani iniu moneo raꞌeteꞌe ḡadinoꞌi.”
Eꞌanoꞌo ani Iesu mazao aroranadu ḡadiniro, “Zuhiꞌa Boro, aꞌe iniu?”
Iesuꞌa naenaeniro, “Eꞌa ꞌuvahu odoga tahiḡa siuvao taradu hauꞌeteꞌe vazeḡaniꞌa revoniꞌuma.” Ebu aniꞌa ꞌuvahu odoga tahiḡa taradu Isakariota vazeḡa Simona ubuga, Iuda haro.
Ebu Iudaꞌa ꞌuvahu odoga eꞌe meirotene, Sataniꞌa zamaḡa diuḡiro. Ebu Iesuꞌa niro, “Ḡaꞌa haḡaiteꞌe haḡaiḡaꞌe ḡarihe haḡaoꞌi.”
Eꞌea ogau radiroteꞌe azaḡa boꞌaḡano vazeni ꞌahoga zuni Iesuꞌe nougadu Iuda mazao ꞌouge rae reiroteꞌe mene ederiro.
Iudaꞌe hadize taufeꞌeteꞌe vazeḡa uꞌano, Iesu tahiꞌa nuꞌe ꞌahige zamariro, “Mui veize eme ura ḡauḡa nu hoitoga veize ga zahara azaḡa ḡau nu zenoga veize Iesuꞌa Iuda umineha.”
Iudaꞌa ꞌuvahu odoga eꞌe madu zogone buaro. Aꞌe ohere zamaḡano.
Zamarotitoꞌi
Iudaꞌa buarotene Iesuꞌa ziro, “Izidi Vaze Ubuga mae ḡihineꞌohe ebu ani uꞌano Badiꞌa mae ḡihineꞌohe.
Ubuga uꞌano Badiꞌa mae ḡihinine, Badiꞌaꞌe aneꞌa bare Ubuga mae ḡihiniꞌuma, ebu aneꞌa zogone ꞌougiꞌuma.
Eḡe tahiꞌatahiꞌa, e zae teite mada tahiḡa daꞌo radiꞌuma. Za eḡe vaḡiꞌuma, rehano ibite Iuda azaḡa boroboro ziroteꞌe teige, za idane ziꞌohe, 'Eḡeꞌa onamiteꞌe habaꞌa zaꞌe aroga mene idaḡa.'
E goro ḡoeꞌa iziga ziniꞌohe. Zaeꞌa zamarotitoꞌi. Eḡeꞌa za zamare borofeꞌeteꞌe teige, zae zuni zamarotitoꞌi.
Zaeꞌa zamarotitine, vaze niduꞌa eꞌe horonadu zaꞌe eḡe tahiꞌatahiꞌa rae ederiꞌuma.”
Peteroꞌa Iesu Oꞌoniꞌuma rae Reiro
Simona Peteroꞌa Iesu ḡadiniro, “Zuhiꞌa Boro, ḡa noꞌe onamiꞌuma?” Iesuꞌa naenaeniro, “Eḡeꞌa onamiteꞌe habaꞌaꞌe ḡaꞌa hegotoga izidi mene idaḡa. Rehano vesuꞌu eḡe hegotiꞌuma.”
Peteroꞌa niro, “Zuhiꞌa Boro, e nougadu izidi ḡa hegotogaꞌe mene idaḡa? Eḡeꞌa ḡae veize ḡabonehe zuni ahetiꞌuma.”
Iesuꞌa naenaeniro, “Ḡa eḡe veize ḡaboneḡo ahetiꞌumahe? Eḡeꞌa hube hune ḡaꞌohe, ꞌizema kokorokuꞌa uganogano ḡa ḡae uḡidu eḡe oꞌohiꞌuma.”
